leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure TanStack Query provider in a React application
Initialize a query client with default options
Implement useQuery hooks to fetch data from an API
Manipulate query states to handle loading, error, and success scenarios
Control query caching behavior by setting staleTime and cacheTime
Integrate TanStack Query with React components to display fetched data
Apply query invalidation to trigger data refetching
